headline: Sánchez announces higher taxes on large housing funds and paid leave to care for children
summary: Socialist leader Pedro Sánchez proposed taxing large funds holding empty homes or tourist flats more heavily. He also proposed a benefit of 100% of the regulatory base for four weeks of childcare leave for children under eight.
why: Housing funds are large investors in residential property, so tax changes on them affect real estate valuations and rental market returns. Spanish fiscal policy also shapes the outlook for the country's sovereign debt.
